verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents first-party skills, docs and tools that turn a user's coding agent into a "LiveKit expert", which points to natural-language operation through an agent. The evidence does not say what those tools can actually do, and the Docs MCP is described only as answering questions in the editor, not as operating the platform. Agent Builder and the voice-agent features are for building NL agents, not for running LiveKit itself by NL. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface for running platform operations (rooms, deployments, telephony), details of what the coding-agent tools can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
